open_points.subject: PortalStore schema creation
open_points.text: “module:portal_store … creates every repository schema when a transaction begins” and “the sqlite unit-of-work backend lowers PortalStore.begin with them … so no generated module calls them”
open_points.question: Does the generated implementation of module:portal_store call the ten repository schema functions during PortalStore.begin, or does some separately generated backend component execute them; if separate, which named module or capability owns that runtime operation?
options: PortalStore.begin calls the ten repository schema functions in accessor order.
A separate backend-generated runtime component calls them, and PortalStore.begin delegates to it.
No generated code calls them, so schema creation must be supplied externally.
open_points.default_guess: Generate the calls inside PortalStore.begin in accessor order.

witness.initial: A validly configured service starts against a new empty SQLite database.
events: A readiness request causes PortalStore.begin to run.
The first use case later accesses a repository table.
outcomes: PortalStore.begin calls the schema functions; readiness creates the tables and the later use case can access them.
No generated module calls the schema functions; the empty database remains without tables and the later use case fails with a storage error unless an unspecified external mechanism created them.
witness.observer: The readiness monitor or the caller of the first repository-backed use case
